question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

______ he fulfills all the conditions, he should not be given the contract.
solution:
The correct answer is 'Unless.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us see the meanings of the given words:
 
 
• **Lest: **Used ​to denote in order to prevent something from happening. (कुछ होने से रोकने के लिए निरूपित करने के लिए **lest **प्रयोग किया जाता है)

 
 
• **Example: ***He gripped his brother's arm **lest **he is trampled by the mob.​ *
 
 
 
• **Since:** Used with a point in time in the past. (अतीत में एक समय के साथ प्रयोग किया जाता है)
 
 
• **Example:** *They've lived in Oxford** since **2004.*
 
 
 
• **Whether: **Used in reference to a choice or alternatives. (किसी विकल्प या विकल्प के संदर्भ में प्रयुक्त।)
 
 
• **Example:** *We're going **whether** it rains or not.*
 
 
 
• **Unless: **We use the conjunction **unless** to mean **‘except if’.** (**unless** का अर्थ है ‘**जब तक**’।) 
 
 
• **Example:*** You can't get a job **unless **you have experience.*
 
 
 
 
 
• **Meaning of the sentence** in Hindi -* ***जब तक** वह सभी शर्तों को पूरा नहीं करता, उसे ठेका नहीं दिया जाना चाहिए।
 
• Therefore, out of all the options, the correct answer is **unless**.

 

**Correct sentence:**__ ***Unless** he fulfills all the conditions, he should not be given the contract.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• Countable nouns, as the term suggests, refer to things that can be counted.
 
• They have singular and plural forms.
 
 
• Example: *table, tables; month, months; pen, pens.*
 
 
 
• Uncountable nouns cannot be counted.
 
• They have a singular form and do not have a plural form.
 
 
• Example: *dirt, rice, information, furniture, and hair.*
